author: ETA PRIME
description:
The new official Steam Machine has everyone talking, but what if you could build something significantly faster for less than half the price? In this video, I take a beaten-up, B-Grade Dell Optiplex office PC and transform it into an absolute 1440p gaming beast running SteamOS 3.8!

Buy a C Grade PC from eBay: https://ebay.us/Jyo8ks
RX 7600 GPU: https://ebay.us/GAORgk
RX 6600 GPU: https://ebay.us/4qv3Ll
Dell 8 pin to 24 pi PSU Adapter: https://amzn.to/4u68NlJ
TFX PSU: https://amzn.to/4nlb224

By combining a cheap 10th Gen Intel Core i7 with an upgraded 500W TFX power supply and an AMD Radeon RX 7600, this sleeper PC build completely outperforms the base model Steam Machine at native 1440p and even handles 4K! We benchmark the most demanding AAA games of 2026, including Forza Horizon 6, Doom: The Dark Ages, Crimson Desert, and Cyberpunk 2077.
